summary: Nine metres of bus-zone kerb on a main road, house 10 m away.
reasons: Bus Zone and passenger loading signs

drivers.seclusion: House 10 m behind the kerb with trees between; others near the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 9 m of kerb, signed as a bus zone and 2-minute passenger loading; no room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a bus lane, close to a junction.
drivers.convention: No parked cars to follow; the signs forbid stopping here.

flags: Bus Zone and Loading Zone signs
Low-lying near Witton Creek is not an issue at about 47 m elevation
sun_shade: Tree canopy on the east side over the kerb.
